title: Kononenkogroup principles
description: A pinned interlude two windows tall: a star of eight hairline rays, fading towards the middle, with tiny numbers at their tips around a centred two-line grotesk heading. While pinned, the star turns half a turn with the scroll (numbers stay upright), the heading slides up out of its masks as a second heading rises into its place, and the stage fades from white to black.
notes: hidden below 1024px by default (desktopOnly), as on the original; pass desktopOnly={false} to show it everywhere
fades to the theme's dark tokens: place it before dark sections
CSS only: without scroll-driven animations the star stands still and the two headings stack
name: kononenkogroup-principles

props.name: rays
props.description: the labels at the tips of the rays, clockwise from the top (eight on the original)

props.name: first
props.description: the heading shown first, one item per line

props.name: second
props.description: the heading that replaces it halfway through, one item per line

props.name: desktopOnly
props.description: hide the whole section below 1024px, as the original does
